description: This file defines the internal class PrefixingBufferWriter, which implements IBufferWriter<byte> and IDisposable. It manages a buffer with a fixed-size header prefix, allowing for efficient writing of payloads with headers, including methods for advancing, initializing, and completing writes, as well as managing internal sequences of memory segments.

classes.name: PrefixingBufferWriter
classes.description: An IBufferWriter<byte> implementation that reserves a fixed-size header prefix and manages payload writing efficiently, including support for private sequence-based writing and buffer initialization.

classes.name: PrefixingBufferWriter.Sequence
classes.description: Manages a sequence of memory segments for writing payload data, supporting dynamic appending, advancing, and recycling segments.

classes.name: PrefixingBufferWriter.Sequence.SequenceSegment
classes.description: Represents a segment in the sequence, extending ReadOnlySequenceSegment<byte>, with methods for setting memory, resetting, and advancing within the segment.

methods.name: PrefixingBufferWriter
methods.description: Constructor initializing the buffer writer with specified prefix size, payload size hint, and memory pool.

methods.name: Advance
methods.description: Advances the write position by the specified count, updating internal counters and private writer if applicable.

methods.name: AdvancePrivateWriter
methods.description: Advances the private sequence writer by the specified count.

methods.name: GetMemory
methods.description: Returns a Memory<byte> for writing, initializing internal buffers if necessary.

methods.name: GetSpan
methods.description: Returns a Span<byte> for writing, using GetMemory if needed.

methods.name: Complete
methods.description: Writes the prefix, commits the payload, and finalizes the buffer to the underlying PipeWriter.

methods.name: CompletePrivateWriter
methods.description: Copies data from the private sequence to the inner writer and advances.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the inner PipeWriter for writing.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the internal state for reuse.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the private sequence writer if it exists.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initial call to acquire memory from the inner writer, reserving space for prefix and payload.
